verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant for platform users is a fair question for a SaaS search platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no in-product assistant that Algolia users can hand their own tasks to. Agent Studio is documented as a way to build end-user-facing agents (shopping assistants, conversational search) grounded in your indices, while the MCP server and agent skills serve external agents rather than providing a built-in assistant.
